final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS c2, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS c3 FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ID AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c3 AS c3, s1.c3 - s2.m AS c4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c3 > s2.m) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3), AVG(c4) FROM s3
